advice.msg: an open key may select a method; call a method by its declared name, and index records of data fields
advice.do: [migration] Only array indices, string indices and declared keys are readable; a computed key needs a `Record<string, T>` type. An open key (a string, a number) on a plain record of data fields is read as an uninterpreted lookup; on a union, a class instance, a record with a method or a getter, or with a symbol or a key call, narrow the receiver, name the field, or bind the key first. In a literal whose type has declared keys, a computed key of literal type names its field and a union of literals is a case split on the key; a `string` key there needs a `Record<string, T>` type.
